title: Connected components as intersections of clopen neighbourhoods
statement: Let $T$ be a topological space satisfying the quasi-compactness, quasi-separatedness and compact-open-basis conditions in [def-weil-spectral-space]: $T$ is quasi-compact, has a basis of quasi-compact open subsets, and the intersection of any two quasi-compact open subsets is quasi-compact. No sobriety assumption is imposed. For every $t\in T$, its connected component is $\bigcap\{V\subseteq T: V\text{ is open and closed and }t\in V\}$.

mathlib_searches.query: The connected component of a point of a spectral space is the intersection of its clopen neighborhoods
mathlib_searches.results: connectedComponent_eq_iInter_isClopen requires compact Hausdorff, not applicable to general spectral spaces. IsClopen.connectedComponent_subset is only one inclusion.

connectedComponent_eq_iInter_isClopen requires T2Space; remaining hits give one inclusion or assume locally connected.
